structure.note: Three classes outstanding on April 30, 2025: 276,762,341 Class A (10 votes each), 62,368,123 Class B (10 votes each, all held by Silver Lake funds) and 344,347,103 Class C (1 vote, NYSE-listed). Dell is an NYSE 'controlled company' because Michael Dell's Class A and Class C shares carry more than 50% of the voting power for electing directors. The 10-K says Michael Dell with the SLD Trust ('MD stockholders') and the Silver Lake funds together held about 91.4% of total voting power on March 17, 2025.

notes: Fiscal 2025 ended January 31, 2025 (Dell's own label; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2025'). Filings: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001571996-25-000034) and 2025 proxy statement (accession 0001193125-25-121698), both read on www.sec.gov. MICHAEL DELL: the 41.4% is stated by the proxy in its 'Percentage Ownership of All Outstanding Dell Technologies Common Stock' column, so no derivation is needed. It includes 423,538 Class C shares held by the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation. It excludes the SLD Trust's 4.6% (Susan Dell's trust, of which the proxy says Mr. Dell 'may be deemed the beneficial owner'). The trust is listed separately as a family holder: the proxy states it is not included in his figure, so the two don't overlap. pctVoting is null because the proxy gives no voting-power percentage for him alone; the 91.4% in the 10-K covers MD and SLP stockholders combined. Holders by size: SLP 9.1%, SLD Trust 4.6%, Vanguard 3.7%; BlackRock (3.3%) is left out by the three-holder limit. Silver Lake's asOf uses the proxy table date because it relies on a January 2025 13D/A plus later Form 4s. BUYBACKS exclude $577 million of repurchases for employee tax withholdings. ROUNDING: dividends of $1,275 million are rounded half-up to 1.28. STOCK COMP: $785 million (cash-flow add-back and non-GAAP reconciliation); the XBRL note value is also 785.

footprint.notes: Dell publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, sites, investment or taxes for FY2025. The 10-K gives approximately 108,000 employees (no geography). Item 2 gives floor space only as U.S. facilities (7.2 million sq ft owned, 1.0 leased) and international facilities (4.2 owned, 5.9 leased), as of Jan 31, 2025; square footage has no unit in this lens, so it is recorded here and not as rows. Owned manufacturing facilities are named only by country, not city ('We own manufacturing facilities located in the United States, Malaysia, China, Brazil, India, Poland, and Ireland'), so they are not listed as sites. Checked the FY2025 10-K and the FY25 'Impact by the Numbers' brief (delltechnologies.com), which has no geographic workforce data; a search of Dell's ESG report listings found no FY25 report with headcount by country or region.
